description: Attach a custom domain you own to an agent. Returns the DNS TXT record to publish as proof of ownership. The domain stays inactive (and serves no traffic, and gets no certificate) until that TXT record is verified.

agent_id.description: The agent to bind the domain to — you must control it

domain.description: The hostname, e.g. agents.example.com (no scheme, port or path)

name: connect_domain
title: Connect custom domain
